{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u042/system/state/workspace/programs/task-2749bdcf.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find full-width/full-height divider lines.
    hlines = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != 0]
    vlines = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != 0]
    if not hlines or not vlines:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    sep = grid[hlines[0]][0]
    hlines = [r for r in hlines if all(x == sep for x in grid[r])]
    vlines = [c for c in vlines if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    rbounds = [-1] + hlines + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + vlines + [w]
    rsegments = [(rbounds[i]+1, rbounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(rbounds)-1)]
    csegments = [(cbounds[i]+1, cbounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(cbounds)-1)]
    # Ignore empty segments and identify the repeated motif: a nonempty tile
    # whose occupancy is not the simple 2x2 marker square.
    tiles = []
    for ri, (ra, rb) in enumerate(rsegments):
        if ra >= rb: continue
        for ci, (ca, cb) in enumerate(csegments):
            if ca >= cb: continue
            vals = [(r-ra, c-ca, grid[r][c]) for r in range(ra, rb) for c in range(ca, cb) if grid[r][c] not in (0, sep)]
            if vals:
                tiles.append((ri, ci, rb-ra, cb-ca, vals))
    motif = None
    for ri, ci, th, tw, vals in tiles:
        mask = {(r,c) for r,c,_ in vals}
        if len(mask) != 4 or not (len({r for r,c in mask}) == 2 and len({c for r,c in mask}) == 2):
            motif = (ri, ci, th, tw, mask)
            break
    if motif is None:
        # General fallback: use the most complex occupied tile.
        if not tiles: return [row[:] for row in grid]
        ri, ci, th, tw, vals = max(tiles, key=lambda t: len(t[4]))
        motif = (ri, ci, th, tw, {(r,c) for r,c,_ in vals})
    _, _, mh, mw, mask = motif
    out = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for r in hlines:
        for c in range(w): out[r][c] = sep
    for c in vlines:
        for r in range(h): out[r][c] = sep
    for ri, (ra, rb) in enumerate(rsegments):
        if ra >= rb: continue
        # The first tile in each band carries its swatch color.
        ca, cb = csegments[0]
        color = next((grid[r][c] for r in range(ra, rb) for c in range(ca, cb) if grid[r][c] not in (0, sep)), 0)
        if color == 0: continue
        for ca, cb in csegments:
            if ca >= cb: continue
            for dr, dc in mask:
                if dr < rb-ra and dc < cb-ca:
                    out[ra+dr][ca+dc] = color
    return out
